def costas_lempel(q, alpha):
    # q is prime power, alpha is primitive element
    # Returns a Costas array of order q-2 using Lempel construction
    # Marks at (i, j) where alpha^i + alpha^j = 1 (mod q), i,j in 1..q-2
    # Returns list x where x[c] = row for column c (0-indexed)
    
    # Precompute powers of alpha
    powers = {}
    val = 1
    for k in range(1, q):  # k from 1 to q-1
        val = (val * alpha) % q
        powers[val] = k
    
    n = q - 2
    x = [None] * n
    
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        ai = pow(alpha, i, q)
        target = (1 - ai) % q
        if target in powers:
            j = powers[target]
            if 1 <= j <= n:
                # i is column (1-indexed), j is row (1-indexed)
                x[i-1] = j - 1  # convert to 0-indexed
    
    return x

# Test for q=17, alpha=3

def verify_costas(x):
    n = len(x)
    # Check permutation
    if sorted(x) != list(range(n)):
        return False, "Not a permutation"
    # Check displacement vectors
    vectors = set()
    for c1 in range(n):
        for c2 in range(c1+1, n):
            dr = x[c2] - x[c1]
            dc = c2 - c1
            if (dr, dc) in vectors:
                return False, f"Duplicate vector: ({dr}, {dc})"
            vectors.add((dr, dc))
    return True, f"Valid Costas array of order {n}"

print(verify_costas(x))
